function Dc(e,t,r,n){let i=t.fields||{},o=new Set([i.unique_key,i.working_name,i.folder_name,i.nickname].map(le).filter(Boolean)),a=e.filter(f=>{let p=f.fields||{};return le(p.decision)==="approve_service_history"&&_n(p.review_status)&&un(p.reviewed_by)&&Zi(p.reviewed_at)&&kc(p.approved_service_amount_thb)&&ne(p.Client).length===1&&ne(p["LINE OFC Import Row"]).length>0}),s=a.filter(f=>ne(f.fields.Client)[0]===r),c=a.filter(f=>{let p=f.fields;if(!o.has(le(p.approved_model_text))||!n.work_lane||le(p.approved_service_type)!==n.work_lane)return!1;let m=Date.parse(p.approved_start_time),u=Date.parse(p.approved_end_time);return Number.isFinite(m)&&Number.isFinite(u)&&Math.abs((u-m)/36e5-n.duration_hours)<.01}),l=new Set(c.map(f=>ne(f.fields.Client)[0])),d=new Set(c.flatMap(f=>ne(f.fields["LINE OFC Import Row"]))),_=c.filter(f=>ne(f.fields.Client)[0]===r).sort((f,p)=>Date.parse(p.fields.approved_service_date)-Date.parse(f.fields.approved_service_date));return{ready:l.size>=2&&d.size>=2,customer_history_count:s.length,comparison_count:c.length,distinct_chat_count:d.size,prior_customer_rate:_[0]?Number(_[0].fields.approved_service_amount_thb):null,min_rate:c.length?Math.min(...c.map(f=>Number(f.fields.approved_service_amount_thb))):null,max_rate:c.length?Math.max(...c.map(f=>Number(f.fields.approved_service_amount_thb))):null}}
